checks.description: ci-api.yml solo corre en push y en PR si cambia api/ o el propio workflow
checks.cmd: yq '[.on.push.paths // [] | sort | join(","), .on.pull_request.paths // [] | sort | join(",")] | join(" | ")' .github/workflows/ci-api.yml

checks.description: ci-web.yml solo corre en push y en PR si cambia web/ o el propio workflow
checks.cmd: yq '[.on.push.paths // [] | sort | join(","), .on.pull_request.paths // [] | sort | join(",")] | join(" | ")' .github/workflows/ci-web.yml

checks.description: smoke.yml corre si cambia api/, web/, compose.yaml, scripts/smoke-test.sh o el propio workflow
images.yml corre si cambia api/, web/ o el propio workflow
ci, ci-api, ci-web, smoke e images declaran concurrency con un grupo por workflow y ref
checks.cmd: for f in ci ci-api ci-web smoke images; do yq '.concurrency.group // "sin grupo"' .github/workflows/$f.yml | grep -vE 'github\.workflow.*github\.ref' | sed "s/^/$f: /"; done

checks.description: cancel-in-progress cancela runs obsoletos solo en los pull requests, nunca en main
checks.cmd: for f in ci ci-api ci-web smoke images; do yq '.concurrency.cancel-in-progress // "ausente"' .github/workflows/$f.yml | grep -vE "event_name *== *'pull_request'" | sed "s/^/$f: /"; done

checks.description: Todo job de ci, ci-api, ci-web, smoke, images y nightly declara timeout-minutes
checks.cmd: for f in ci ci-api ci-web smoke images nightly; do yq '.jobs // {} | to_entries | .[] | select(.value | has("timeout-minutes") | not) | .key' .github/workflows/$f.yml | sed "s/^/$f: /"; done

checks.description: nightly.yml se programa con un cron de cinco campos
nightly.yml se lanza a mano con un input target de tipo choice: all, ci-api, ci-web o smoke
Solo el job dispatch de nightly.yml pide actions: write; la raíz se queda en contents: read
github-script recibe el target por env: con valor por defecto all, sin ${{ }} dentro de script:
Toda uses: remota de tus workflows está fijada por SHA de 40 caracteres con el tag en comentario
Un workflow tuyo terminó en success disparado por repository_dispatch
checks.cmd: gh run list --event repository_dispatch --status success --json databaseId --jq length

checks.description: nightly.yml terminó en success sobre el último commit de main
checks.cmd: git fetch -q origin main && gh run list --workflow nightly.yml --commit "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion'

checks.description: ci-web.yml terminó en success sobre el último commit de main en un run lanzado por workflow_dispatch
checks.cmd: git fetch -q origin main && gh run list --workflow ci-web.yml --event workflow_dispatch --commit "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion'
